automationNotes: Doc: [Delete a Personalize Project](https://www.contentstack.com/docs/personalize/delete-personalize-project). **Destructive** — permanently removes the project. Use a disposable project; set **`PERSONALIZE_DELETE_PROJECT_CARD_CONTAINS`** to the card substring to delete (overrides **`PERSONALIZE_PROJECT_CARD_CONTAINS`** / **`DAL_PERSONALIZE_PROJECT_SEARCH`** for this flow only). **`stage: delete`** runs after `main` module flows. Handlers: `rules/core/actionRules.ts` (Personalize delete + modal **DELETE** + **Delete**).
